exposure: medication type (bupivacaine with 2% lignocaine, bupivacaine with fentanyl, bupivacaine with tramadol)
cohort: 274 patients who underwent spinal anesthesia for cesarean section at Khyber Teaching Hospital Peshawar between January 2023 to September 2023
finding: The study found that spinal hypotension is frequently seen during elective caesarean deliveries after spinal anesthesia.
